name: EnsinAR
summary:
Turn your virtual workbench into a space for scientific exploration.

EnsinAR brings together 21 modules about life, the universe and matter. Explore cells and osmosis, cell division, bacteria, the Solar System, Earth movements, lunar phases, the water cycle, atomic models, chemical bonds, plants and animals from Brazilian biomes. Investigate electromagnetic induction, molecular geometry and polarity, and braking distance.
